title: Pin to Dock Pins to a Hidden Dock
author: gconey

status.label: Hidden-dock routing is fixed; nested command pinning is extension-defined
status.detail: Merged PR 48723 changed the pin dialog to list only displays where the dock is enabled. The later single-monitor examples concern extension commands that do not expose independently pinnable command IDs.

next_action.label: Track the merged dock fix and extension behavior
next_action.reason: Do not start a competing dock-routing design from the mixed thread.

judgment.rationale: The original hidden-primary-dock failure has a merged direct fix. The maintainer clarified that the later media-control examples are governed by extension-provided IDs and available bands, not the same monitor-routing defect.
evidence: The original report includes a multi-monitor hidden-dock repro and a diagnostic ZIP.
PR 48723 is merged and titled CmdPal: Only list available docks when pinning.
Current CommandPaletteContextMenuFactory.GetDockEnabledMonitors filters monitor configs to enabled displays.
The maintainer explained that nested extension commands can only be pinned when the extension supplies a command ID/band.
judgment.recommended_action: Treat PR 48723 as the fix for the original report and route any remaining extension-specific pinning complaint to the extension owner.

fix_assessment.rationale: Merged PR 48723 directly implements the original request to avoid pinning to a hidden dock.

issue_context.summary: Merged PR 48723 changed the pin dialog to list only displays where the dock is enabled. The later single-monitor examples concern extension commands that do not expose independently pinnable command IDs.
known_information: The report was filed against PowerToys 0.100.2.
The original failure targets a hidden dock on the primary display.
A later commenter describes individual media-control commands on a single display.
The maintainer distinguishes dock routing from extension-defined pin capability.
inferences: Any current recurrence of the original multi-monitor case would be a regression of PR 48723.
Commands without stable IDs or a separately exposed band cannot be made independently pinnable by the host alone.
issue_context.analysis: The thread now contains two mechanisms. The direct host-side monitor-routing issue has merged code; the nested-command behavior requires extension metadata and should not create a second host fix artifact.
initial_investigation: Read all comments and the attached diagnostic reference.
Checked PR 48723 and confirmed it is merged.
Inspected CommandPaletteContextMenuFactory.GetDockEnabledMonitors and the nearby pin-to-dock flow.
